segments.text: So why are the CDC, why is Big Pharma, why are these other groups so scared of your conference, of your big summit on March 25th?
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So it's a vaccine safety research foundation is sponsoring, along with Warner Mendenhall, a conference that I, Mary Holland of the Children's Health Defense, Dr. Malone, Dr. Corey, Dr. McCullough, a bunch of people are going to be there.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And in Atlanta, Georgia, people can still come if they want to.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The reason why there's been a tax on it is because the point and purpose of the conference is to find a way to get legal remedy for the people that have been injured by the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And the concern by those in positions of power is that they believe that they have abolished any mechanism or means of meaningful remedy for injury from the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: Because of the immunity by the PREP Act, immunity under the Childhood Immunizations Law, all of these aggregate immunities under the contract that Pfizer signed with the Department of Defense, which said, by the way, if you, the government, give this to anybody, we can never be sued for it.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They assume that those immunities are impregnable.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And we're going to try to find ways to break through those immunities to see whether you can sue based on the employer mandating it, whether you can sue under various state tort law theories that may be outside of the governance of these immunity laws, challenge the laws themselves as unconstitutional.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: A woman in Washington, D.C. just filed suit because her two kids were given the vaccine at a Ronald McDonald's mobile clinic
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And the kids were tricked into getting it by lies and deceits by a prominent Georgetown healthcare doctor who is running those clinics.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So that's why we'll get continued blowback and continued efforts to not have, you know, the press won't cover it just like they won't cover the Brooke Jackson case.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: They don't want people to know there might be remedies and relief out there for the injuries they suffered from the vaccine.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
